In my VAST experience of treasure hunting — and I have hunted treasures on FIVE continents, I'll have you know — the cellar is ALWAYS where the real prize is hidden! Upstairs is for AMATEURS — riddles on mantelpieces, broken machines requiring committees to operate — BAH! Down here, in the DEPTHS, is where a man of TRUE discernment finds his fortune! Oh, Reginald Foxworth, you MAGNIFICENT scoundrel!

Whatever this machine 'reveals,' WE see it first! Not him! Rufus, mate — you look like a man what knows his way around machinery! You, Clara, and Danny — three operators, right there! What d'you say?
